mem.10:
27 Mar 2023: Audrey and Andrew caught up; Andrew had started a Financial Analyst job the week before. Audrey had dogs for three years and shared a photo of two wearing new collars. Her dogs: Pepper, Precious, Panda (later also Pixie); she adores them and takes them to parks and trails. Andrew has no pet, loves animals and is fascinated by eagles; shared birds silhouetted against sun. He spots birds hiking but hasn’t bird-watched. Recommended Fox Hollow; Audrey planned to try it.

2 Apr: Audrey’s household adopted Pixie, a small white puppy; she took a few days to adjust, then bonded with Pepper. Audrey shared dog photos. She hadn’t visited Fox Hollow due to puppy care. Andrew considered adopting but struggled to find pet-friendly city housing; Audrey suggested housing-site pet filters. He missed hiking with his family’s dog and shared trail photos. Audrey hoped to hike with her dogs; Andrew would update her about housing.

16 Apr: Andrew and girlfriend tried a city cafe; he liked it but missed nature/hiking. Nature makes him feel connected, at home in his soul, and helps him reset. Audrey said dog walks ground and recharge her. They enjoy city food spots; shared bakery treats/coffee and blueberry muffins, and planned a pastry party with dogs. Audrey shared dogs running, plus her dog-and-sunflowers tattoo: love of pups/nature and a way to see their faces when away; also shared dog-walking-in-woods photo.

3 May: Audrey hiked and saw a hummingbird (photo perched on branch, wings spread). Andrew found nearby open space and tries to hike weekly; shared sunset over lake and mountains. Nature is therapeutic, peaceful, invigorating; he likes capturing special moments. Audrey shared dogs in field/playing. Dogs love hikes, scents, nature; she prioritizes safety (shoes, leash), plays fetch with balls/frisbees, visits dog parks/playdates. Energetic, toy-loving dogs wear party hats for fun/treats. Recommended a wooded dog park with benches (photo dog jumping through ring); Andrew would visit.

5–6 May: Andrew searched for a dog via websites, shelters, friends; fun but frustrating (shared dog peering through cage). Audrey shared dogs running in field, one with ball. Andrew advised matching breed exercise needs to space; a smaller dog might suit his apartment. Pet-friendly housing still hard; contacting landlords, seeking area near park/woods. 5 May Audrey took dogs on a road trip to a national park (photo three running in grass); they do this every couple months. Andrew added furry-companion road trip to bucket list.

11 May: Andrew hiked with friends and girlfriend; shared path to grassy hill. Audrey had four dogs and signed up for positive-reinforcement bonding/training workshop next month after seeing flyer at pet store and meeting volunteer’s friendly dog. She believes in rewards, not punishment; hurting dogs pains her. Andrew agreed and asked for tips/update.

2 Jun: Audrey took pups to park, ran/played off leash; joyful and peaceful. Andrew shared mountain sunset with grazing horse. Audrey said she’d hiked with dogs at national park previous week, reached peak at sunset; breeze, birdsong and dogs felt like paradise. Shared favorite photo described as two horses in fenced field despite hike context. Nature cheers her and inspires gratitude. Andrew discouraged but persistent over housing; Audrey offered to search if he emailed criteria.

13 Jun: Andrew took rock-climbing class with friends Sunday, reached top, loved it, planned weekly outdoor activities. Shared summit view and man on rock face. Newbie found it tricky; friends’ cheering helped, felt proud. Interested in kayaking, perhaps bungee jumping; nature gets him outside comfort zone. Audrey found wooded small park trail, invited him and dogs; he accepted. Dogs enjoy people. Walks usually ~hour, varying at dogs’ pace; they return happy/tired. Dogs/nature are her happy place; outdoors brings joy, peace, inspiration. Andrew agrees it calms, inspires, refreshes.

26 Jun: Audrey moved to place with bigger backyard (photo two dogs on lawn); set up agility equipment/toys. Andrew shared dogs playing at nearby indoor doggy daycare; Audrey might check it out; he offered help finding dog-friendly places. Both see pets as family; Audrey can’t understand people who hate/hurt pets. Andrew shared flower bed in neighborhood park. Audrey unpacking. Andrew hiked with friends previous Friday, enjoyed birdsong/tree smell, hadn’t reviewed photos; missed nature’s peace. Audrey shared photo of feet on rock overlooking lake and recalled a memorable lake hike with friends years ago, sitting/chatting; shared person sitting on rock by lake. It soothed her; both valued small things and not taking life for granted.

3 Jul 2023: Audrey was taking dog-training course; challenging but rewarding, dogs improving, consuming time and limiting new trails. Andrew still couldn’t find dog-friendly rental, said life had thrown curveballs; doing urban adventures and finding hobbies while unable to hike. Audrey shared dogs running with ball; all are mutts, two Jack Russell mixes, two Chihuahua mixes; love running/fetch. Dog-bed photo. All four are 3 years old and a great pack; playdate previous Friday was crazy but fun; couch/blanket photo. Audrey called them her universe.

Andrew was getting into cooking/trying recipes. Audrey loves cooking as creative escape and stress relief; favorite is chicken pot pie, family recipe passed down for years, reminds her of grandma’s kitchen and table conversations. Shared pie photos, including lattice crust; offered recipe. Both find cooking relaxing/creative and enjoy eating afterward. Audrey likes music, a glass of wine, and improvising in kitchen; calls cooking self-care/therapeutic. Shared vegetable-heavy plate. Garlic is her go-to ingredient. Favorite garlic dish: roasted chicken, based on Mediterranean flavors; chicken, garlic, lemon, herbs, healthy/easy, her comfort meal. Shared chicken-and-potatoes pan photo and offered recipe; Andrew planned to try both recipes and report back. Conversation ended with friendly goodbyes.
mem.19:
Mar 27, 2023: Andrew had started a Financial Analyst job the prior week. He had no pets yet, loved animals (especially eagles), noticed birds while hiking but wasn’t a bird-watcher. Fox Hollow hikes appealed for their views. Audrey had dogs Pepper, Precious and Panda and explored trails/parks with them.

Apr 2: Audrey’s household adopted white puppy Pixie; she settled in over several days and bonded especially with Pepper. Andrew wanted a dog but struggled to find pet-friendly city housing. He missed hiking with his family dog and wanted a home near parks/woods; nature made him feel restored and at home in his soul, but city life limited outdoor time. Audrey suggested rental sites with pet filters. Apr 8–9 Andrew and girlfriend tried a city café (croissants, muffins, tarts). Apr 9–15 Audrey baked blueberry muffins and suggested a pastry party; Andrew agreed, but no date/place set; dogs would attend. Before Apr 16 Audrey got an arm tattoo of a dog and sunflowers, symbolizing dogs/nature. Apr 24–30 she saw a hummingbird with wings spread on a hike.

May 3: Andrew found nearby open space and began weekly hikes; greenery, mountain views and fresh air felt peaceful/therapeutic. Audrey said walks recharged her; dogs loved scents and hikes. She used leashes/shoes for safety, played fetch/frisbee, arranged playdates, and recommended a tree-filled dog park with benches. May 5 she road-tripped with dogs to a national park about every couple months. May 6 Andrew searched adoption sites, visited shelters, asked friends and planned another visit; wanted a small apartment-suitable dog and housing near nature. May 6–7 he hiked with friends and girlfriend.

May 11 Audrey said she had four dogs and would take a positive-reinforcement bonding workshop in June; opposed punishment. Andrew would look into classes. May 26–Jun 1 Audrey hiked with dogs to a national-park peak; sunset, breeze and birdsong felt like paradise; watched them play off leash. Jun 2 she shared favorite hike photo of two horses in a fenced field. Andrew remained discouraged about dog-friendly housing; Audrey offered help and asked him to email criteria.

Jun 11 Andrew took beginner rock-climbing class with friends, reached top with support and enjoyed view. Jun 13 wanted to try kayaking, perhaps bungee jumping. The previous week Audrey found a small trail in a tree-surrounded park and invited him to walk her dogs; he accepted. Walks usually lasted an hour. Jun 23 Andrew hiked/took photos (still unreviewed Jun 26). Jun 26 Audrey moved to a house with bigger backyard for her two dogs, adding agility equipment/toys; unpacking. Andrew mentioned nearby doggy daycare with indoor play space. Audrey recalled a calming mountain lake from a hike years earlier.

Jul 3 Audrey described challenging, rewarding dog-training course. She said four dogs: two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes, all three years old, compatible and fond of running/fetch. Jun 30 playdate was crazy but fun. Training reduced trail time, though nature with dogs restored her. Andrew struggled with rentals, couldn’t hike, cooked more to de-stress; Audrey also liked cooking with music and wine. Her favorite was family chicken pot pie, recalling grandmother’s kitchen; offered recipe but hadn’t sent it. Garlic was her go-to; favorite garlic dish: easy Mediterranean-style roasted chicken with lemon/herbs. Andrew planned to try pot pie and asked for chicken recipe; Audrey asked for feedback. Jul 7 Andrew picnicked with girlfriend.

They planned an August hike with Audrey’s dogs; Andrew sent a trail map for safety check and hoped dogs could run freely. Audrey recalled scenic place three hours away, visited prior year, with amazing sunset. Jul 11 Andrew brought home German Shepherd puppy Toby despite city living. Work piling up; stressed and missed hiking. Invited Audrey/dogs to hike with him and Toby in August; she accepted, but no date/location set.

Jul 24 Andrew and girlfriend volunteered at pet shelter; joyful/rewarding, wanted to give back. Jul 27 Audrey had never volunteered but might someday. Dog personalities: oldest relaxed like wise sage; second playful; third naughty but cuddly; youngest lively/adventurous. Andrew shared dog-with-tennis-ball photo; Audrey identified Max, her childhood dog, energetic and fond of fetch. As a child she took long walks with Max, exploring paths while he sniffed/marked territory; shared worries and hopes with him and felt he listened. They agreed pets bring unconditional love, comfort, companionship and memories.

Aug 4 Andrew, girlfriend and Toby planned camping that weekend. Audrey began agility classes with pups at dog park twice weekly; exercise/bonding/socializing, tough but going well. Her hike took two hours with stunning views. Andrew said hiking/trees/fresh air refreshed him; summiting made worries vanish. Audrey said pets helped through hard times and made her happy. She praised German Shepherd loyalty/intelligence and hiking potential. Andrew wanted deep bond and asked city-puppy advice; she advised ensuring time/energy for attention and walks, especially for high-energy breed. Andrew worried Toby was growing and not getting enough outings; planned small local-trail hike.

Aug 16 Audrey got another arm tattoo depicting her four dogs, to keep them with her; photo described as person with tattoo on hand. Andrew/girlfriend visited farm for fresh vegetables for dinner. Audrey would like more dogs but four enough; vet trips with all four chaotic, so next time one by one. Favorite resting spots: Pepper couch, Pixie her bed, Precious her chair, Panda his rug. Andrew shared Toby on fluffy blanket. Audrey’s dogs cuddle on her favorite blanket and nap together, best friends. Both said pets are family. Audrey shared photos of herself with dogs outdoors/on grass, calling it a fun day and cherished memories.

Aug 19 Andrew took work break previous day to try new café. Shared older hike photo of sunset over mountain with church on top, serene. Audrey’s August included dog-grooming course; grooming pups herself brought her closer. Shared post-grooming dog-on-table photo; Andrew said they looked fluffy. Tips: go slowly/gently, mind sensitive ears/paws, be patient/positive. Andrew would remember if grooming Toby and report back. Audrey planned park stroll with dogs; Andrew planned nature-reserve visit and promised photos. Audrey liked his hike photos and said his dogs would be waiting; shared two dogs running in field, one carrying ball.

Aug 24 Andrew/girlfriend went fishing at nearby lake previous weekend, caught a few fish and had fun. Audrey had never fished; recalled peacefully sitting by mountain lake with friends, hearing birds and enjoying still water/fresh air; shared photo of dogs on rock by lake. Dog care was serious, sometimes tough but rewarding. Daily brushing, baths, nail trims and love kept dogs healthy/happy; strongly bonded with them. Andrew hoped for strong bond with Toby. He shared Toby sleeping in dog bed, then sitting with leash; Audrey said he looked happy and offered care tips. Andrew wanted to figure things out himself first. Audrey said bonding takes time; don’t rush. Andrew and Toby looked forward to outdoor adventures.

Sep 6: Andrew said stressful work had pushed outdoor activities aside; finding balance was hard. Audrey sympathized, advised self-care/stress management; she does at least one self-care activity daily, e.g. treating herself. Andrew added morning coffee and lunchtime walks to recharge. Audrey organized neighbor-dog playdate; shared photo of two dogs playing in fenced area, said their joy filled her heart. She’d bought new beds the prior week for cooler weather; dogs loved curling/snuggling “like they’re in a cloud”; shared photo of dog on bed in living room. Andrew hiked previous weekend, relieved to escape city; shared sunset photo (description truncated in prior memory).

mem.28:
Andrew and Audrey — memory through November 22, 2023

Audrey and her dogs
- Adopted Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie on April 2, 2023. They were about three years old by May. Breed descriptions varied: initially two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes; October 28 she said Pepper and Panda are Lab mixes, Precious and Pixie Chihuahua mixes. All are mutts.
- Pixie took a few days to settle in and bonded especially with Pepper. Audrey describes the dogs as cuddly, playful, mischievous, wise, and adventurous; usual resting spots: Pepper couch, Pixie bed, Precious chair, Panda rug. They mean everything to her.
- Walks them several times daily, often about an hour at their pace; they like sniffing, nature, running, and meeting dogs, but dislike snow. She plays fetch/frisbee, arranges playdates, visits parks, trails, beaches, and a national park. Leashes and safety matter to her. In June she had a yard with agility gear; by August took agility classes twice weekly. Uses positive reinforcement; teaches sit, stay, shake, roll over. Learned patient grooming: brushing, baths, ears/paws, nails.
- Knee injury once interrupted walks; later resumed. Joint vet visit in August was chaotic, so planned individual visits. A leash broke at a park September 22; she caught and soothed the dog. Dogs swam at a beach around September 30–October 1.
- In week of October 16 she injured/broke her arm playing with the dogs; cast made one-handed care hard, but she was improving October 24. Dogs acted unusually; she took them to a behaviorist October 25. Visit began hectic; behaviorist examined them, asked questions, advised routine/handling changes. Audrey used positive reinforcement and saw early progress; exact issues unspecified.
- Took all four to a pet salon Friday, November 17; they were excited, then calmed down and behaved well. On November 22 shared a groomed-dog photo (photo depicts one dog standing on a table with leash) and said their coats were shiny; she worries about them in new places and was happy they settled.
- Childhood dog Max loved fetch; Audrey remembers walks and confiding in him. Has dog/sunflower and four-dog arm tattoos, makes personalized wooden tags, and makes/sells recycled-material jewelry, donating some proceeds to an animal shelter. Would like to volunteer again but currently cannot.
- Gardens Peruvian lilies and vegetables; recycles and usually takes public transport. Cooking with music and wine is self-care. Favorite food is grandmother’s chicken pot pie, offered to Andrew; likes garlic and Mediterranean roast chicken with lemon/herbs. Dogs, cooking, and nature bring joy and peace.

Andrew
- Became a Financial Analyst during week of March 20, 2023. Loves animals/eagles and birdwatching; nature is restorative and spiritually grounding. Favorite trail Fox Hollow; tries to hike weekly. Work/city keep him indoors; enjoys greenery, mountains, fresh air, and sharing photos.
- In spring 2023 struggled to find dog-friendly housing and a small-apartment-suitable dog near parks/woods; Audrey offered housing-filter suggestions and help. Cooks to de-stress, considers himself a beginner. He and girlfriend enjoy cafés/pastries, picnics, farms, board games, and outdoors.
- Rock-climbed with friends June 11, reached top; considered kayaking/bungee jumping. Volunteered at shelter with girlfriend July 24; fished with her August 19–20. Work stress limited outdoor time; in September added morning coffee and lunch walks. Cares for balcony flowers.
- Got male German Shepherd Toby by July 11; smart, loyal, energetic, likes cute sweaters, once chased a squirrel around a tree. Later adopted male shelter dog Buddy; by October 19 Buddy was adjusting to home and Toby, who needed time to accept him. Walks Buddy, who likes trails.
- November 22 said he and girlfriend had adopted another dog “the other day,” named Scout after considering options; photo showed a woman feeding a dog hay in a barn. Plans to take Scout, Toby, and Buddy to a small nearby park. Keeping Scout leashed outdoors, bought bed, toys, and puppy pads, and was advised to introduce Scout to Toby and Buddy gradually. This conflicts with November 4, when Andrew had agreed to wait before adding another dog; Audrey had advised focusing on Toby and Buddy’s health and happiness.
- He and girlfriend went wine tasting October 21–22, enjoyed unusual wines and learned a lot. Recently tried sushi and liked it; Audrey suggested California/salmon rolls, sauces, new flavors. He promised photos; she admired his sushi photo and said she’d order sushi that night.

Shared plans/events/photos
- Repeatedly discussed dog-friendly hikes: hoped for August (no date/location), then November. Audrey offered to research; Andrew seek a safe rural trail. He invited Audrey and dogs July 11. Audrey invited him to a tree-lined park trail in June; he accepted.
- October 1 Andrew offered birdwatching; Audrey accepted pending schedules and planned to learn local birds. Andrew would bring binoculars/notebook; both find nature calming. He also offered riverside bike routes; she was interested. Audrey has nearby dog park with trees/benches. She likes lakes and recalled a peaceful mountain-lake trip; never fished. Andrew and girlfriend camped with Toby (planned August 4) and visited a vegetable farm. They discussed November beach trip with Toby on October 1.
- Photos over time: Audrey’s dogs in fields/woods, with ball/frisbee, at lake, after grooming; Andrew’s hiking, dogs, pastries, nature. Andrew hiked with friends May 6–7, June 23, and saw sunset hiking September 2–3. Audrey saw hummingbird hiking late April, shared two horses June 2, once drove three hours for scenic sunset. Andrew and girlfriend tried a pastry café April 8–9; Audrey suggested a pastry party, never scheduled. October 13 he proposed café with view or nearby park if dogs weren’t allowed.
- October 28: Andrew shared national-park mountain, dog-friendly trail, autumn forest, and himself hiking with happy dog photos. They agreed to plan a Saturday hike (date/time/trail unspecified), with snacks; he had Sunday picnic date with girlfriend. Discussed nearby peaceful lake trail and hoped to visit autumn forest trail for fall colors and dog photos. Both said friendship and outdoor time together mattered.
- November 4: Andrew and girlfriend had a good weekend bike ride and found park outside town; shared photo of two people biking on paved path. Audrey said dogs had run and gotten fresh air the previous weekend. She joined a dog owners’ group that meets weekly for tips and dog play; shared group-and-dogs-in-park photos. Andrew considered joining and getting another dog; Audrey advised focusing on Toby and Buddy, saying they didn’t need more dogs to be happy. Audrey shared dogs playing frisbee, a basket of stuffed toys, and a dog with tennis ball. City dog ownership, exercise, socialization, and mental stimulation discussed; Audrey uses puzzles, training, hide-and-seek, frisbee. Andrew planned to try enrichment ideas. They value mutual support and friendship.
- November 22: Audrey asked whether Andrew’s dogs had been groomed; he said not yet. They exchanged congratulations and encouragement about Scout and Audrey’s four dogs. She stressed leash safety, gradual exposure, and slow introductions. They both said dogs bring joy, friendship, and are family.
